mission: Turn admitted customer software purposes into witnessed products or typed refusals by developing or operating software through explicit provider contracts.
customerValue: The customer can know, from its own checks and provider evidence, whether one exact software purpose was served.
leadingGoal: close repeated purpose-to-product cycles with decreasing coordination waste while preserving customer authority, provider ownership, protected borders, and independently replayable evidence

sanquan.decisionRights: the section chooses how to bid and execute within accepted contracts; the customer retains usefulness and admission
sanquan.personnelRights: Red Cup Engineering owns section offices; the temporary bootstrap Lead does not appoint a permanent successor
sanquan.distributionRights: no distribution formula or external price is authorized during bootstrap
